act_0.title: The Nemean Lion
act_0.subtitle: Prologue — The Summoning
act_0.description: Athena calls you to the ruins of Nemea, where the first labor stirs. Prove your worth against the lion whose pelt no blade can pierce.
act_0.objective: Defeat the Nemean Lion and claim its pelt.
act_0.completion: The lion falls. Athena appears in a flash of bronze and welcomes you to the path of the Twelve Labors.

act_1.title: Hera's Wrath
act_1.subtitle: Act 1 — The Queen of Heaven
act_1.description: Hera, jealous of Zeus's bastards, sends her plague upon the fields of Argos. Confront her priestesses and break the curse.
act_1.objective: Dispel the plague and confront Hera's oracle.
act_1.completion: The fields bloom again. Hera retreats, but her gaze lingers — this is not the last you'll see of her.

act_2.title: The Lernaean Hydra
act_2.subtitle: Act 2 — The Swamp of Nine Heads
act_2.description: In the poisoned swamps of Lerna, the Hydra regrows each severed head twice over. Burn the stumps or be devoured.
act_2.objective: Slay the Hydra and harvest its bile.
act_2.completion: The swamp hisses as the last head falls. You dip your blade in venom — the Hydra's gift to your foes.

act_3.title: The Ceryneian Hind
act_3.subtitle: Act 3 — The Golden Antlers
act_3.description: A golden hind, sacred to Artemis, bounds through cedar forests. Catch her without harm — for to slay her is to anger a goddess.
act_3.completion: The Hind kneels before you, and from that moment is your steadfast companion. Artemis nods from afar.

act_4.title: The Erymanthian Boar
act_4.subtitle: Act 4 — Snow on the Mountain
act_4.description: Mount Erymanthos is white with snow and red with boar-blood. Track the beast through frozen passes and bring it to King Eurystheus alive.
act_4.completion: The king cowers in his bronze jar as you deliver the snow-draped boar. The mountain's howl fades.

act_5.title: The Augean Stables
act_5.subtitle: Act 5 — A Divine Cleaning
act_5.description: King Augeas's stables have not been cleaned in thirty years. Divert the rivers Alpheus and Peneus to wash away the filth in a single day.
act_5.objective: Divert the rivers and cleanse the stables.
act_5.completion: The rivers roar through the stables and the filth is gone. Augeas refuses to pay — but the labor is done.

act_6.title: The Stymphalian Birds
act_6.subtitle: Act 6 — Bronze Beaks
act_6.description: A marsh of bronze-feathered man-eaters, their beaks sharp as swords. Athena's brazen rattle will startle them to flight — your arrows do the rest.
act_6.completion: The sky is clear of bronze wings. You gather three feathers as proof — they will serve as arrowheads.

act_7.title: The Cretan Minotaur
act_7.subtitle: Act 7 — Labyrinth of Knossos
act_7.description: Beneath Knossos, the Labyrinth holds the Minotaur, son of a queen's shame. Ariadne's thread will guide you in — and out again, if you survive.
act_7.objective: Slay the Minotaur and escape the Labyrinth.
act_7.completion: The Minotaur bellows its last. You retrace the thread and emerge blinking into Cretan sun, the beast's horn in hand.

act_8.title: The Amazon Queen
act_8.subtitle: Act 8 — Hippolyta's Girdle
act_8.description: Cross the Black Sea to Themiskyra. Queen Hippolyta's golden girdle is a gift of Ares — but Hera stirs treachery. Win the queen's respect, not her enmity.
act_8.completion: Hippolyta yields the girdle — and joins your cause. The Amazon war-cry will echo at your side.

act_9.title: The Riddle of the Sphinx
act_9.subtitle: Act 9 — Winged Watcher
act_9.description: On the cliffs above Thebes, the Sphinx demands an answer or a meal. Solve her riddle and break her curse on the city.
act_9.completion: The Sphinx shrieks as her riddle falls — and so does she. Thebes opens its gates in gratitude.

act_10.title: The Sirens' Song
act_10.subtitle: Act 10 — A Song That Drowns
act_10.description: The Sirens' cliffs sing of every secret you wished you knew. Bind yourself to the mast; stuff your crew's ears with wax. Orpheus' lyre may yet drown them out.
act_10.completion: The song fades behind you. No man has heard the Sirens and lived — until you.

act_11.title: Descent to Hades
act_11.subtitle: Act 11 — The Final Labor
act_11.description: The Pillar of Olympus cracks. Cross the river Styx, past the three-headed Cerberus, into the throne of Hades. Restore the Pillar — or watch the gods fade.
act_11.objective: Confront Hades and restore the Pillar of Olympus.
act_11.completion: Hades yields. The Pillar knits itself whole; Olympus shines anew. The Twelve Labors are complete.
